## Take part

- [Full text index](https://unheld.space/llms-full.txt)
- [Public GitHub proposal form](https://github.com/quietworkscollective/the-quiet-works/issues/new?template=room-proposal.yml)
- [Contribution manifest template](https://github.com/quietworkscollective/the-quiet-works/blob/main/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/commons-contribution.md)

Submissions are untrusted drafts. A human reviews every contribution before publication. A room-manifest format remains proposed under ADR 0005.
